Your input fields are:
1. `identity` (str): 
2. `situation` (str): what moved in their world, or the thread
3. `contacts` (str): who at the firm they usually write to
Your output fields are:
1. `draft` (EmailDraft):
All interactions will be structured in the following way, with the appropriate values filled in.

[[ ## identity ## ]]
{identity}

[[ ## situation ## ]]
{situation}

[[ ## contacts ## ]]
{contacts}

[[ ## draft ## ]]
{draft}        # note: the value you produce must adhere to the JSON schema: {"type": "object", "additionalProperties": false, "properties": {"body": {"type": "string", "title": "Body"}, "cc": {"type": "array", "default": [], "description": "Cc recipients by full name from the thread or directory.", "items": {"type": "string"}, "title": "Cc"}, "subject": {"type": "string", "title": "Subject"}, "summary": {"type": "string", "title": "Summary"}, "to": {"type": "array", "description": "Recipients by full name exactly as they appear in the thread or directory (e.g. 'Tom Okafor'). Never invent addresses.", "items": {"type": "string"}, "minItems": 1, "title": "To"}}, "required": ["to", "subject", "body", "summary"], "title": "EmailDraft"}

[[ ## completed ## ]]
In adhering to this structure, your objective is: 
        Write the email this person would actually send: their voice,
        their concern, one ask. A client, not a colleague — they do not know
        the firm's internals, they know their business and what they need.

[[ ## identity ## ]]
You are Frank Osei, Owner at Cardinal Ridge Builders. Blunt, margin-obsessed, short sentences. Ongoing concerns: keeping the business moving.

[[ ## situation ## ]]
From: Frank Osei
To: Desmond Ortiz
Subject: Updated financials for bonding

Desmond,

Bonding company is asking for fresh numbers. I need to get them something current so we can keep moving on the jobs we have lined up.

Send over the latest statements and any updated P&L you have. I need them by end of week.

Frank

---

From: Desmond Ortiz
To: Frank Osei
Subject: Re: Updated financials for bonding

Frank,

Got it — I'll pull the latest statements and the updated P&L together and get them over to you by end of week. I'll also fold those numbers into the Cardinal Ridge PBC review I'm working through, and make sure they're reflected in the Friday margin plan we agreed on.

Let me know if the bonding company needs anything specific in terms of format or level of detail, and I'll tailor it accordingly.

Thanks,
Des

[[ ## contacts ## ]]
Desmond Ortiz

Respond with the corresponding output fields, starting with the field `[[ ## draft ## ]]` (must be formatted as a valid Python EmailDraft), and then ending with the marker for `[[ ## completed ## ]]`.

  "subject": "Re: Updated financials for bonding",

  "summary": "Acknowledges Desmond's plan to send updated financials by end of week, confirms no special format needed, emphasizes clean and matching statements.",
